usage: agentware migrate [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--list | --apply]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --list                report pending migrations, read-only (the default)
  --apply               apply pending additive migrations and stamp .schema
                        (idempotent; refuses restructuring migrations)
